common_dynamic_policy.independent_history_start: empty per run; within-run facts retained unless ablated
common_dynamic_policy.native_dynamic_adapter: shared observed-change trigger; restart source search per phase; keep accepted config and measured in-run history; no added GP/Reflexion

attainment.reference: .9 * paired Default median 20-second window P95 per phase

primary_metrics: first sustained target confirmation from phase start

adapter.name: OnlineTune dynamic adapter
adapter.encoder: observed SQL structure, not unavailable pretrained LSTM or future phase labels
adapter.routing: past windows only; StandardScaler/PCA3/DBSCAN(.7,8), RBF SVM gamma=auto
adapter.novel_context: provisional region when distance to observed region center exceeds .25
adapter.default_reference: budgeted measured phase anchor; historical raw utilities recentered on activation
adapter.model_reuse: region keyed raw observations and upstream GP hyperparameters retained on return
adapter.cross_region_transfer: objective-only transfer for >10% gains above observed 90th percentile
adapter.objective: inverse measured P95; original objective-difference and relative-constraint GPs
